panel_findings.statement: In the LixiLan-L pivotal trial panel, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin (+ metformin + 1 OAD), the sample size is n=365 for Insulin glargine 100 units/mL and n=366 for SOLIQUA.
In the LixiLan-L panel, the LS mean change in body weight from baseline was -0.7 ± 0.2 kg with SOLIQUA versus +0.7 ± 0.2 kg with Insulin glargine (p < 0.0001).
In the SoliMix pivotal trial panel, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin + OADs after 26 weeks, the sample size is n=444 for Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 and n=443 for SOLIQUA.
In the SoliMix panel, after 26 weeks, the change in weight from baseline was -0.7 ± 0.2 kg with SOLIQUA versus +1.2 ± 0.2 kg with Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 (p < 0.0001).
In the propensity score matching analysis (LixiLan-L and GGD2), in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulins, the sample size is n=195 for Basal bolus therapy and n=195 for SOLIQUA.
In the propensity score matching analysis, the mean change in weight from baseline was -0.62 ± 0.24 kg with SOLIQUA versus +0.70 ± 0.24 kg with Basal bolus therapy (p < 0.0001).
